actions.en: fortifies the spleen and harmonizes the stomach

raises and bears qi

indications.zh: 胃痛、呕吐、腹胀、泄泻、便秘
indications.en: stomach pain, vomiting, abdominal distension, diarrhea, constipation
knee pain, lower limb atrophy and impediment

description_zh: 足三里为足阳明胃经合穴，亦为胃之下合穴，列入四总穴及马丹阳天星十二穴，素有“保健要穴”之称。临床以健脾和胃、扶正培元见长，为治疗消化系统疾患及全身虚损性疾病的首选穴。古人云“若要安，三里常不干”，强调其灸治保健的重要地位。
description_en: ST-36 (Zusanli) is the he-sea point and lower he-sea point of the Stomach channel, and one of the four command points ("for the abdomen, take Zusanli") and Ma Danyang's twelve heavenly star points. It is the single most important point for fortifying the Spleen and Stomach, supplementing qi, and supporting upright qi. Historically celebrated as the premier health-preservation moxibustion point, it is indispensable in the treatment of gastrointestinal disorders, general vacuity, and immune support.

actions.en: relaxes the sinews and quickens the connecting vessels
drains heat and clears summerheat
cools the blood and resolves toxin

indications.en: lower back pain, lower limb atrophy and impediment

description_zh: 委中为足太阳膀胱经合穴及膀胱之下合穴，亦属四总穴之一，有“腰背委中求”之训。该穴长于舒筋通络、清热凉血，为治疗腰背疼痛的要穴，兼治下肢痿痹、腹痛吐泻及暑热疔疮等症。三棱针点刺放血为其特色刺法。
description_en: BL-40 (Weizhong) is the he-sea point and lower he-sea point of the Bladder channel, and one of the four command points ("for the back and lumbus, take Weizhong"). It excels at relaxing the sinews and freeing the connecting vessels, as well as cooling the blood and draining heat. It is the primary point for lumbar and back pain, and three-edged needle pricking to bleed is its characteristic technique, making it clinically versatile for both musculoskeletal and heat-toxin conditions.

actions.en: diffuses the lung and dissipates evil
frees and regulates the conception vessel

description_zh: 列缺为手太阴肺经络穴，八脉交会穴之一（通于任脉），亦属四总穴。其“头项寻列缺”之歌诀广为传诵，表明该穴善治头项部疾患。临床以宣肺解表、通调任脉为主要功效，常用于外感风邪引起的头痛、咳嗽及咽喉诸症。
description_en: LU-7 (Lieque) is the luo-connecting point of the Lung channel and one of the eight confluent points of the extraordinary vessels (connecting to the Conception Vessel). It belongs to the four command points ("for the head and nape, seek Lieque"). Clinically it excels at diffusing Lung qi, releasing the exterior, and treating disorders of the head, neck, and throat. Its dual role as a Lung luo point and extraordinary vessel confluent makes it uniquely effective for both respiratory and Ren Mai pathology.

resolves the exterior and drains heat

indications.en: headache, red swollen painful eyes, epistaxis, toothache
deviation of mouth and eye, deafness
febrile disease with absence of sweating or excessive sweating

description_zh: 合谷为手阳明大肠经原穴，四总穴之一，素有“面口合谷收”之称，为全身最常用穴位之一。该穴镇痛力强，善治头面五官诸疾；又能解表泄热，广泛应用于外感发热；与太冲配伍称“四关穴”，调畅全身气机。孕妇慎用。
description_en: LI-4 (Hegu) is the yuan-source point of the Large Intestine channel and one of the four command points ("for the face and mouth, take Hegu"). Renowned for its powerful analgesic effect, it is among the most frequently needled points in clinical practice. It excels at treating disorders of the head, face, and sense organs, and is a key point for resolving the exterior in febrile disease. Paired with LR-3 (Taichong) as the "four gates," it powerfully regulates qi flow throughout the body. Contraindicated for vigorous stimulation in pregnancy.

actions.en: levels the liver and extinguishes wind
clears heat and disinhibits dampness
frees the connecting vessels and stops pain

description_zh: 太冲为足厥阴肝经原穴兼输穴，是疏肝理气、平肝息风的代表穴位。临床凡肝气郁结、肝阳上亢、肝风内动等肝系病证多取此穴。与合谷相配称“四关穴”，共奏疏调气机之功，为针灸临床最经典的穴位配伍之一。
description_en: LR-3 (Taichong) is both the yuan-source point and shu-stream point of the Liver channel, making it the principal point for coursing the Liver, rectifying qi, and leveling Liver yang. It is essential in treating Liver qi stagnation, Liver yang rising, and Liver wind stirring internally. Paired with LI-4 as the "four gates," it is one of the most celebrated point combinations in acupuncture for regulating the qi dynamic of the entire body.

actions.en: quiets the heart and calms the spirit
rectifies qi and harmonizes the stomach
relaxes the chest and stops pain

description_zh: 内关为手厥阴心包经络穴，八脉交会穴之一（通于阴维脉）。该穴宁心安神、理气和胃、宽胸止痛，是治疗心胸胃疾患的核心穴位。临床广泛应用于心悸、胸痛、胃痛、呕吐、眩晕、失眠等症，尤以止呕效果显著，现代研究亦证实其抗心律失常的作用。
description_en: PC-6 (Neiguan) is the luo-connecting point of the Pericardium channel and one of the eight confluent points of the extraordinary vessels (connecting to the Yin Linking Vessel). It is the foremost point for quieting the Heart, calming the spirit, harmonizing the Stomach, and relaxing the chest. Its antiemetic action is particularly notable and well-supported by modern research. Clinically indispensable for palpitations, chest pain, nausea, vomiting, and insomnia.

calms the spirit and promotes sleep

indications.en: spleen-stomach weakness, borborygmus, abdominal distension, diarrhea
irregular menstruation, flooding and spotting, vaginal discharge

description_zh: 三阴交为足太阴脾经穴，是足三阴经（脾、肝、肾）的交会穴，故能同调脾、肝、肾三脏。该穴功善健脾益血、调肝补肾、安神助眠，为妇科要穴，广泛用于月经不调、崩漏、带下及不孕等症。孕妇禁针。
description_en: SP-6 (Sanyinjiao) is the crossing point of the three foot yin channels (Spleen, Liver, and Kidney), giving it the unique ability to influence all three yin organs simultaneously. It fortifies the Spleen and boosts blood, regulates the Liver, and supplements the Kidney. It is the single most important point in gynecology, widely used for menstrual irregularities, uterine bleeding, vaginal discharge, and infertility. Contraindicated for needling during pregnancy.

actions.en: raises yang and upbears the fallen
rouses the brain and opens the orifices
calms the spirit and settles the mind

description_zh: 百会位于头顶正中，为督脉与诸阳经交会穴，“百脉之会”之名体现其统率全身阳气的地位。该穴升阳举陷、醒脑开窍、安神定志，临床常用于治疗头痛眩晕、中风失语、脱肛、子宫脱垂等气陷之证，亦是针灸治疗精神神志疾病的要穴。
description_en: DU-20 (Baihui) sits at the vertex of the head, where the Governing Vessel meets all the yang channels — hence its name, "Hundred Convergences." It is the premier point for raising yang and upbearing the sunken, and for rousing the brain and opening the orifices. Clinically essential for headache, dizziness, wind stroke, aphasia, organ prolapse (rectal, uterine), and spirit-mind disorders including insomnia and poor memory.

description_zh: 关元位于脐下三寸，为任脉与足三阴经交会穴，又是小肠之募穴。该穴培元固本、温肾壮阳、补益气血，为强壮保健要穴。临床广泛应用于肾虚阳衰之阳痿、不孕、遗尿等生殖泌尿系统疾患，以及一切虚损性疾病。灸法效果尤佳。孕妇慎用。
description_en: REN-4 (Guanyuan) lies on the anterior midline 3 cun below the umbilicus and is the front-mu point of the Small Intestine as well as the crossing point of the three foot yin channels with the Conception Vessel. It cultivates the source, secures the root, and warms Kidney yang. It is one of the most powerful points for supplementing original qi, treating reproductive and urogenital vacuity conditions, and reversing general exhaustion. Moxibustion at this point is particularly effective.

indications.en: decline and exhaustion of organ qi, lack of strength

description_zh: 气海位于脐下一寸半，为任脉穴，其名“气海”意为一身之气汇聚之处。该穴益气助阳、调经固经，是治疗气虚、阳虚以及妇科经带疾病的重要穴位。临床常与关元配伍使用，灸治效果尤为突出，对虚脱、气陷等急危重症亦有回阳固脱之功。
description_en: REN-6 (Qihai), the "Sea of Qi," is located 1.5 cun below the umbilicus on the Conception Vessel. Its name reflects its status as the gathering place of the body's qi. It boosts qi and assists yang, making it a key point for all qi vacuity and yang vacuity conditions. Frequently combined with REN-4 (Guanyuan) and treated with moxibustion, it is also used for menstrual irregularities, prostration, and collapse of qi.

actions.en: harmonizes the stomach and fortifies the spleen
downbears counterflow and disinhibits water

description_zh: 中脘位于脐上四寸，为胃之募穴、腑会穴，又是手太阳小肠经、手少阳三焦经、足阳明胃经与任脉的交会穴。该穴和胃健脾、降逆利水，为治疗一切胃腑疾病的首要穴位，临床用于胃痛、腹胀、呕吐、泄泻及黄疸等消化系统疾患，针灸皆宜。
description_en: REN-12 (Zhongwan) is the front-mu point of the Stomach and the hui-meeting point of the fu organs, located on the anterior midline 4 cun above the umbilicus. It is also the crossing point of the Small Intestine, Triple Burner, and Stomach channels with the Conception Vessel. As the primary point for all fu-organ disorders, it harmonizes the Stomach, fortifies the Spleen, and downbears counterflow. It is indispensable for epigastric pain, distension, vomiting, diarrhea, and jaundice.

frees and disinhibits the sensory orifices

description_zh: 风池位于项后枕骨下方凹陷中，为足少阳胆经要穴。其名“风池”意为风邪聚积之处，长于平肝息风、祛风解毒、通利官窍。临床广泛用于头痛眩晕、外感风邪、目赤肿痛、鼻渊等头面五官疾患，为治疗内风与外风的通用要穴。深部为延髓，针刺时须严格控制方向和角度。
description_en: GB-20 (Fengchi) lies in the depression between the sternocleidomastoid and trapezius muscles below the occiput — its name, "Wind Pool," reflects its role as a site where wind evil gathers and can be expelled. It levels the Liver, extinguishes wind, and frees the sensory orifices. Clinically it is a primary point for headache, dizziness, wind-strike, eye and nasal disorders, and the common cold. Care must be taken with needling depth and angle, as the medulla oblongata lies deep to this point.

invigorates yang and strengthens the lower back

description_zh: 太溪为足少阴肾经原穴兼输穴，是补肾益精、滋阴壮阳的代表穴位。肾为先天之本，太溪作为其原穴，可调节肾之阴阳，临床广泛用于肾虚所致的腰痛、耳鸣、头晕、咽痛、齿痛等症。诊脉时太溪脉搏动的有无亦可判断肾气盛衰。
description_en: KI-3 (Taixi) is both the yuan-source point and shu-stream point of the Kidney channel, making it the principal point for supplementing the Kidney in all its aspects — yin, yang, and essence. Because the Kidney is the root of prenatal qi, Taixi is broadly applicable to lumbar pain, tinnitus, dizziness, sore throat, toothache, and cough due to Kidney vacuity. The palpation of the Taixi pulse is also a classical diagnostic indicator of the state of Kidney qi.

actions.en: quiets the heart and calms the spirit
frees the channels and quickens the connecting vessels

description_zh: 神门为手少阴心经原穴兼输穴，是宁心安神的第一要穴。心主神明，神门直通心气，故对一切心神不宁之症（心悸、失眠、健忘、惊恐、癫狂）均有显著疗效。该穴还能通经活络，用于心经循行部位的疼痛，为针灸治疗心系及精神疾患的核心穴位。
description_en: HT-7 (Shenmen), the "Spirit Gate," is the yuan-source point and shu-stream point of the Heart channel. As the Heart governs the spirit-mind (shen), Shenmen is the single most important point for quieting the Heart and calming the spirit. It is clinically essential for palpitations, insomnia, poor memory, fright, anxiety, and mania. Its name directly conveys its function as the gateway through which the spirit is accessed and settled.

actions.en: resolves the exterior and abates fever
clears the heart and settles the mind

description_zh: 大椎位于第七颈椎棘突下，为督脉穴，是手足三阳经与督脉的交会穴，故有“诸阳之会”之称。该穴善于解表退热、清心安神，是治疗一切热病的要穴。临床广泛用于外感发热、疟疾、咳嗽气喘等症，灸法亦常用于虚寒性疾患的温阳散寒。
description_en: DU-14 (Dazhui) lies below the spinous process of C7 and is the crossing point of all six hand and foot yang channels with the Governing Vessel — hence its title, "Meeting of All Yang." It is the premier point for resolving the exterior and abating fever in febrile disease, and also for clearing heat in malaria. With moxibustion it can warm yang to treat vacuity-cold patterns. Its unique convergence of all yang channels makes it broadly effective for both repletion-heat and vacuity-cold conditions.

stops cough and calms wheezing

description_zh: 肺俞为肺之背俞穴，位于第三胸椎棘突下旁开一寸半。背俞穴直接对应相关脏腑，肺俞可调补肺气、止咳平喘，为治疗一切肺系疾病的基础穴位。临床用于咳嗽、气喘、胸满、盗汗等症，常与中府（肺之募穴）俞募配穴使用。不宜深刺，须防气胸。
description_en: BL-13 (Feishu) is the back-shu point of the Lung, located 1.5 cun lateral to the spinous process of T3. As a back-shu point it directly influences its paired organ, making it fundamental for regulating and supplementing Lung qi, stopping cough, and calming wheezing. It is commonly combined with the front-mu point of the Lung (LU-1 Zhongfu) in shu-mu pairing. Depth of insertion must be carefully controlled to avoid pneumothorax.

actions.en: fortifies the spleen and boosts qi
harmonizes the stomach and transforms dampness

description_zh: 脾俞为脾之背俞穴，位于第十一胸椎棘突下旁开一寸半。该穴直接调理脾脏功能，健脾益气、和胃化湿，是治疗脾胃疾患的核心背俞穴。临床广泛用于腹胀、腹泻、呕吐、水肿、黄疸等脾失健运之症。灸法尤宜，常与足三里、中脘等穴配伍使用。
description_en: BL-20 (Pishu) is the back-shu point of the Spleen, located 1.5 cun lateral to the spinous process of T11. It directly regulates Spleen function, fortifying the Spleen, boosting qi, harmonizing the Stomach, and transforming dampness. It is a core point for treating all Spleen-Stomach transport-and-transformation failures, including abdominal distension, diarrhea, vomiting, edema, and jaundice. Moxibustion is especially effective, often combined with ST-36 and REN-12.

location.en: 1.5 cun lateral to the lower border of the spinous process of L2

actions.en: boosts the kidney and assists yang
strengthens the lower back and disinhibits water

description_zh: 肾俞为肾之背俞穴，位于第二腰椎棘突下旁开一寸半，是补肾强腰的要穴。临床以益肾助阳、强腰利水为主要功效，广泛用于遗精、阳痿、遗尿、月经不调、腰痛等肾虚诸症。灸法温补效果显著，常与关元、太溪等穴配伍应用。
description_en: BL-23 (Shenshu) is the back-shu point of the Kidney, located 1.5 cun lateral to the spinous process of L2. It is the primary back-shu point for boosting the Kidney, assisting yang, strengthening the lumbar region, and disinhibiting water. Clinically essential for seminal emission, impotence, enuresis, menstrual irregularities, and lower back pain. Moxibustion is highly effective at this point and it is frequently combined with REN-4 (Guanyuan) and KI-3 (Taixi).

As a he-sea point of the yangming channel, it is especially effective for clearing yangming heat, and is widely used for dermatological conditions including urticaria and scrofula.

description_en: SP-9 (Yinlingquan) is the he-sea point of the Spleen channel, located in the depression posterior and inferior to the medial tibial condyle. It is the foremost point for fortifying the Spleen and disinhibiting dampness, as well as for freeing the Triple Burner water passages. It is the first-choice point in all dampness-predominant conditions including edema, jaundice, abdominal distension, and diarrhea. It is also used locally for knee pain.

Clinically used for headache, stiff neck, wind stroke with aphasia, and epilepsy. Deep needling is strictly prohibited due to the proximity of the medulla oblongata.

description_en: DU-4 (Mingmen), the "Gate of Life," is located on the posterior midline below the spinous process of L2 on the Governing Vessel. It is intimately connected with Kidney yang — the "ministerial fire" (ming men zhi huo) that is the root of all yang activity in the body. It warms the Kidney, invigorates yang, and strengthens the lumbar region. It is essential for Kidney yang vacuity presenting as impotence, seminal emission, lumbar pain, and menstrual irregularities. Moxibustion is the preferred treatment method.

description_en: REN-8 (Shenque), the "Spirit Tower Gate," is located at the center of the umbilicus on the Conception Vessel. Needling is strictly prohibited; treatment is exclusively by moxibustion, classically through a layer of salt or ginger. It is the premier emergency point for warming yang and rescuing from counterflow collapse (yang desertion), used for wind stroke with prostration and reversal cold of the limbs. It is also used for chronic diarrhea, dysentery, rectal prolapse, and edema.

As a well point it is powerful for reviving consciousness in emergencies (corpse-like reversal, heatstroke), and for enriching yin and downbearing fire. It treats vertex headache, insomnia, and infantile convulsions, exemplifying the principle of "treating above by selecting below."

description_en: SJ-17 (Yifeng) is located behind the earlobe. It is a principal point for ear disorders and facial paralysis. It sharpens the hearing for tinnitus and deafness, and dispels wind for facial paralysis and deviation of the mouth.

drains heat and reduces swelling

description_zh: 耳门位于耳屏上切迹前方，为治疗耳疾之要穴。常与听宫（SI-19）、听会（GB-2）配伍使用，称'耳三穴'。
description_en: SJ-21 (Ermen) is located anterior to the supratragic notch. It is a principal point for ear disorders, frequently combined with SI-19 (Tinggong) and GB-2 (Tinghui) as the 'three ear points.'

description_en: SJ-23 (Sizhukong) is the final point of the Triple Burner channel, located at the lateral end of the eyebrow. It brightens the eyes and stops pain for eye disorders, headache, and eyelid twitching. It also treats facial paralysis. Moxibustion is contraindicated.

description_zh: 瞳子髎为足少阳胆经起始穴，手太阳、手足少阳三经交会穴。位于目外眦旁，善治眼目诸疾，为眼科常用穴。临床以祛风明目为主，治疗目赤肿痛、迎风流泪、视物模糊等症。
description_en: GB-1 (Tongziliao) is the starting point of the Gallbladder channel and a meeting point of the Hand Taiyang, Hand Shaoyang, and Foot Shaoyang channels. Located beside the outer canthus, it is a primary point for ophthalmological disorders including red painful eyes, lacrimation, blurred vision, and corneal opacity.

description_zh: 听会为足少阳胆经穴，位于耳前，为治疗耳部疾患的要穴。临床以开窍聪耳、祛风通络见长，主治耳聋、耳鸣、中耳炎等耳疾，兼治牙痛、面瘫。针刺时须嘱患者张口取穴。
description_en: GB-2 (Tinghui) is a key auricular point of the Gallbladder channel. Located anterior to the ear, it excels at opening the portals to sharpen hearing and is a primary point for deafness, tinnitus, and otitis media. It is also effective for toothache and facial paralysis. The patient must open the mouth during needling.

levels the liver and extinguishes wind
disinhibits the gallbladder and harmonizes the stomach

description_zh: 率谷为足太阳与足少阳交会穴，位于耳上颞区。善治偏头痛，为少阳头痛常用穴，兼能平肝息风、和胃止呕。临床对偏头痛、眩晕耳鸣等少阳经病候疗效尤佳。
description_en: GB-8 (Shuaigu) is a meeting point of the Foot Taiyang and Foot Shaoyang channels in the temporal region. It is a primary point for migraine and Shaoyang-type headache, and also treats dizziness, tinnitus, and vomiting. Its location directly above the ear makes it particularly effective for lateral headache patterns.

description_zh: 完骨为足太阳与足少阳交会穴，位于乳突后下方。善治风邪上扰所致的头痛、面瘫、项强等症，兼能安神助眠。为头面部疾患的常用配穴。
description_en: GB-12 (Wangu) is a meeting point of the Foot Taiyang and Foot Shaoyang channels, located behind the mastoid process. It is effective for headache, facial paralysis, stiff neck, and insomnia, treating wind-evil patterns affecting the head and face.

description_en: GB-14 (Yangbai) is a meeting point of the Foot Shaoyang and Yangwei vessel, located on the forehead above the eyebrow. It excels at treating frontal headache, eye disorders, and facial paralysis. It is frequently needled with through-insertion toward Yuyao for ptosis of the eyelid.

description_zh: 肩井为手足少阳与阳维脉交会穴，位于肩上要处。临床以祛风活络、通经下乳著称。善治颈肩痛、乳疾及难产，为催乳催产要穴。因深部为肺尖，严禁深刺，孕妇禁针。
description_en: GB-21 (Jianjing) is a meeting point of the Hand Shaoyang, Foot Shaoyang, and Yangwei vessel. Located on the shoulder, it is clinically important for neck and shoulder pain, difficult labor, and lactation insufficiency. CAUTION: deep needling is strictly prohibited due to the proximity of the lung apex; contraindicated in pregnancy.

description_en: GB-24 (Riyue) is the front-mu collecting point of the Gallbladder. As the mu point, it is the primary diagnostic and therapeutic point for Gallbladder disorders including cholecystitis, jaundice, and hypochondriac pain. It also treats vomiting and acid reflux by descending counterflow qi.

actions.en: fortifies the spleen and disinhibits water
warms the kidney and strengthens the lumbus
rectifies qi and stops pain

description_zh: 京门为肾之募穴，位于侧腰第十二肋端。以健脾利水、温肾壮腰见长，为诊治肾腑病证的首选募穴。主治肾炎水肿、小便不利及腰胁疼痛。
description_en: GB-25 (Jingmen) is the front-mu collecting point of the Kidney. Located at the free end of the 12th rib, it is the primary mu point for Kidney disorders including nephritis, edema, and urinary difficulty, and is effective for lumbar and lateral costal pain.

description_en: GB-26 (Daimai) is the meeting point of the Foot Shaoyang and the Dai Mai (Girdle Vessel). It excels at regulating menstruation and treating vaginal discharge, and is a primary point for gynecological conditions including leukorrhea, irregular menstruation, and uterine prolapse.

description_zh: 环跳为足少阳与足太阳交会穴，列入马丹阳天星十二穴，位于臀部深处。为治疗腰腿痛及坐骨神经痛的首选穴，其祛风化湿、通经活络之力尤强。临床取穴常令患者侧卧屈膝，针感向下肢放射为佳。
description_en: GB-30 (Huantiao) is a meeting point of the Foot Shaoyang and Foot Taiyang channels, and one of Ma Danyang's twelve heavenly star points. It is the paramount point for sciatica and lumbago, located deep in the gluteal region. Needle sensation radiating down the leg indicates optimal stimulation. It powerfully dispels wind-damp and frees the channels for lower limb motor disorders.

indications.en: lower limb atrophy and impediment, hemiplegia

description_en: GB-31 (Fengshi) is located on the lateral thigh, famously located where the fingertip touches when standing with arms at the sides. Its name ("Wind Market") reflects its powerful wind-dispelling action. It is a key point for generalized itching, urticaria, and lower limb wind-impediment patterns.

description_zh: 膝阳关位于膝外侧，以治膝关节疾患见长。善祛风散寒、利关节止痛，为治疗膝骨性关节炎、膝关节肿痛及屈伸不利的局部要穴。
description_en: GB-33 (Xiyangguan) is located on the lateral knee, above the lateral femoral epicondyle. It is a local point for knee osteoarthritis, knee pain, swelling, and restricted flexion-extension, excelling at dispelling wind-cold from the joint.

description_zh: 阳陵泉为足少阳胆经合穴、胆之下合穴，八会穴之筋会，列入马丹阳天星十二穴。作为筋会，统治全身筋病，举凡筋脉拘急、关节疼痛均可取用。兼能疏肝利胆、清利湿热，为胁痛、黄疸的要穴。现代临床常用于急性腰扭伤及落枕的远端取穴治疗。
description_en: GB-34 (Yanglingquan) is the he-sea point and lower he-sea point of the Gallbladder, the hui-meeting point of sinews (one of the eight influential points), and one of Ma Danyang's twelve heavenly star points. As the influential point of sinews, it commands all sinew disorders throughout the body. It is equally important for coursing the Liver and Gallbladder to treat hypochondriac pain, bitter taste, and jaundice. In modern practice, it is frequently used as a distal point for acute lumbar sprain and torticollis.

description_en: GB-37 (Guangming) is the luo-connecting point of the Gallbladder channel. Its name ("Bright Light") reflects its primary function of brightening the eyes. It is an important distal point for eye disorders including night blindness, blurred vision, and eye pain. As a luo point, it also addresses Gallbladder channel pathology.

description_en: GB-39 (Xuanzhong, also known as Juegu/"Severed Bone") is the hui-meeting point of marrow (one of the eight influential points) and the great luo of the three foot yang channels. As the influential point of marrow, it governs all bone marrow and brain marrow disorders. It is a critical point for wind-stroke hemiplegia, stiff neck, and is valued in modern practice for osteoporosis and cerebrovascular disease.

description_en: GB-40 (Qiuxu) is the yuan-source point of the Gallbladder channel. Located near the lateral malleolus, it regulates Gallbladder qi and is used for hypochondriac pain, bitter taste, and Gallbladder repletion patterns. It is also an important local point for lateral ankle sprains.

actions.en: courses the liver and disinhibits the gallbladder

description_zh: 足临泣为足少阳胆经输穴，八脉交会穴之一（通于带脉），与外关穴配伍应用。临床以疏肝利胆、通调带脉见长，善治偏头痛、乳疾及月经不调。作为输穴兼八脉交会穴，地位独特，主治范围广泛。
description_en: GB-41 (Zulinqi) is the shu-stream point of the Gallbladder channel and one of the eight confluent points of the extraordinary vessels (connecting to the Dai Mai/Girdle Vessel), paired with SJ-5 (Waiguan). It courses the Liver and Gallbladder, regulates the Girdle Vessel, and is clinically important for migraine, breast disorders, and menstrual irregularities.

description_en: GB-43 (Xiaxi) is the ying-spring point of the Gallbladder channel, pertaining to water in the five phases. As a ying-spring point, it excels at clearing heat from the channel, treating Gallbladder heat patterns such as headache, dizziness, red eyes, and tinnitus.

description_zh: 足窍阴为足少阳胆经井穴，五行属金。井穴善清本经热邪、开窍醒神，用于少阳经急症。主治偏头痛、目赤、耳聋及咽痛，点刺出血效果尤佳。
description_en: GB-44 (Zuqiaoyin) is the jing-well point of the Gallbladder channel, pertaining to metal in the five phases. As a well point, it powerfully clears channel heat and opens the portals. It is used for acute Shaoyang patterns including migraine, red eyes, deafness, and sore throat. Pricking to bleed is especially effective.

description_en: LR-1 (Dadun) is the jing-well point of the Liver channel, pertaining to wood in the five phases. It is a key point for hernia (as the Liver channel encircles the genitalia), and for uterine flooding. As a well point, it restores yang and opens the portals in emergencies such as epilepsy and syncope. Moxibustion is particularly effective for hernia.

location.zh: 足背，第一、二趾间，趾蹼缘后方赤白肉际处
location.en: On the dorsum of the foot, between the 1st and 2nd toes, proximal to the web margin at the junction of red and white skin

actions.en: clears the liver and drains fire
cools the blood and quiets the spirit
extinguishes wind and stops spasm

indications.en: headache, dizziness, red swollen painful eyes
hypochondriac pain, bitter taste in the mouth

description_zh: 行间为足厥阴肝经荥穴，五行属火。荥穴主治「身热」，因肝属木、荥属火，木火相生，故为清泻肝经实火的第一要穴。凡肝火上炎所致头痛、目赤、口苦、失眠、易怒均为其主治范畴。泻法为主。
description_en: LR-2 (Xingjian) is the ying-spring point of the Liver channel, pertaining to fire in the five phases. With wood generating fire, this is the premier point for draining repletion Liver fire. It is indispensable for Liver fire flaring patterns: headache, red eyes, bitter taste, insomnia, and irritability. Reducing technique is standard.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

location.zh: 足内踝前，胫骨前肌腱内侧凹陷中，内踝尖前约1寸
location.en: Anterior to the medial malleolus, in the depression medial to the tendon of tibialis anterior, approximately 1 cun anterior to the tip of the medial malleolus

actions.en: courses the liver and rectifies qi
clears and disinhibits the lower burner
relaxes the sinews and benefits the joints

description_zh: 中封为足厥阴肝经经穴，五行属金。经穴主治「喘咳寒热」，善疏肝理气、清利下焦湿热。为治疗疝气、遗精及小便不利的常用穴，兼治内踝部疼痛。
description_en: LR-4 (Zhongfeng) is the jing-river point of the Liver channel, pertaining to metal in the five phases. It courses the Liver and clears the lower burner, treating hernia, seminal emission, and urinary difficulty. It is also a useful local point for medial ankle pain.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

location.zh: 小腿内侧，内踝尖上5寸，胫骨内侧面中央
location.en: On the medial side of the lower leg, 5 cun above the tip of the medial malleolus, on the center of the medial surface of the tibia

actions.en: courses the liver and rectifies qi
regulates menstruation and stops vaginal discharge
clears and disinhibits the lower burner

indications.en: irregular menstruation, red and white vaginal discharge
difficult urination, testicular swelling and pain

description_zh: 蠡沟为足厥阴肝经络穴。络穴联络表里经，故既治肝经本经病变，亦可治胆经病。因肝经循行绕阴器，故善治下焦及生殖系统疾患，为调经止带、治疗阴痒阴挺的常用穴。
description_en: LR-5 (Ligou) is the luo-connecting point of the Liver channel. As a luo point, it treats both Liver and Gallbladder channel pathology. Because the Liver channel encircles the genitalia, it is particularly effective for genitourinary and gynecological disorders including leukorrhea, genital itching, and menstrual irregularity.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

location.zh: 小腿内侧，内踝尖上7寸，胫骨内侧面中央
location.en: On the medial side of the lower leg, 7 cun above the tip of the medial malleolus, on the center of the medial surface of the tibia

actions.en: courses the liver and rectifies qi
regulates menstruation and stops bleeding
rectifies qi and stops pain

description_zh: 中都为足厥阴肝经郄穴。郄穴善治本经急性病证及出血证，故中都尤善止血，为治疗崩漏、月经过多及产后恶露不绝的要穴。兼治疝气及少腹疼痛。
description_en: LR-6 (Zhongdu) is the xi-cleft point of the Liver channel. Xi-cleft points excel at treating acute and painful conditions as well as blood disorders of their respective channels. Zhongdu is therefore a critical point for uterine bleeding emergencies, menorrhagia, and persistent lochia, alongside hernia and lower abdominal pain.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

location.zh: 膝内侧，屈膝时，当膝关节内侧端，股骨内上髁后缘，半腱肌、半膜肌止端前缘凹陷中
location.en: On the medial side of the knee, with the knee flexed, in the depression above the medial end of the popliteal crease, posterior to the medial epicondyle of the femur, anterior to the insertion of semimembranosus and semitendinosus

actions.en: clears and disinhibits damp-heat
regulates menstruation and stops vaginal discharge
enriches and nourishes the liver and kidney

indications.en: irregular menstruation, vaginal discharge, genital itching

description_zh: 曲泉为足厥阴肝经合穴，五行属水，水能涵木。合穴主治「逆气而泄」，善清利下焦湿热，治疗泌尿生殖系统疾患。兼能滋养肝肾之阴，用于肝肾阴虚证。为膝内侧痛的局部要穴。
description_en: LR-8 (Ququan) is the he-sea point of the Liver channel, pertaining to water in the five phases (water nourishes wood). It excels at clearing damp-heat from the lower burner for genitourinary disorders, and enriches Liver-Kidney yin. It is used for urinary difficulty, menstrual disorders, impotence, and is a local point for medial knee pain.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

location.zh: 侧腹部，第十一肋骨游离端下际
location.en: On the lateral side of the abdomen, at the lower border of the free end of the 11th rib

actions.en: courses the liver and fortifies the spleen
rectifies qi and disperses accumulation
transforms phlegm and dissipates nodules

description_zh: 章门为脾之募穴，八会穴之脏会，足厥阴与足少阳交会穴。作为脏会，统治五脏疾患；作为脾之募穴，善治脾胃运化失常。临床以疏肝健脾、理气消积见长，为肝脾不调、腹胀泄泻及痞块的要穴。
description_en: LR-13 (Zhangmen) is the front-mu collecting point of the Spleen and the hui-meeting point of the zang-organs (one of the eight influential points). It commands all five zang-organ disorders. Clinically it courses the Liver and fortifies the Spleen, treating Liver-Spleen disharmony, abdominal distension, diarrhea, and abdominal masses. Its dual role as Spleen mu and zang hui makes it uniquely important.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

location.zh: 乳头直下，第六肋间隙，前正中线旁开4寸
location.en: Directly below the nipple, in the 6th intercostal space, 4 cun lateral to the anterior midline

special_categories: 足太阴厥阴阴维脉交会穴

actions.en: courses the liver and rectifies qi
quickens the blood and transforms stasis
fortifies the spleen and harmonizes the stomach

indications.en: chest and hypochondriac fullness and pain

description_zh: 期门为肝之募穴，足太阴、足厥阴与阴维脉交会穴。作为肝之募穴，为诊治肝胆疾患的首选穴。善疏肝理气、活血化瘀，主治胸胁胀痛、肝炎及呕吐呃逆。张仲景《伤寒论》中常用期门治疗肝气犯胃之证。
description_en: LR-14 (Qimen) is the front-mu collecting point of the Liver and a meeting point of the Foot Taiyin, Foot Jueyin, and Yinwei vessel. As the Liver mu point, it is the foremost point for diagnosing and treating Liver and Gallbladder disorders. It courses Liver qi, quickens blood stasis, and is used for chest and hypochondriac pain, hepatitis, and vomiting. Zhang Zhongjing frequently prescribed it in the Shang Han Lun for Liver qi invading the Stomach.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

location.zh: 尾骨端下，尾骨端与肛门连线的中点处
location.en: Below the tip of the coccyx, at the midpoint of the line connecting the tip of the coccyx and the anus

actions.en: frees the governing vessel and regulates the intestines
secures desertion and stops diarrhea
calms and quiets the spirit

description_zh: 长强为督脉起始穴，亦为督脉络穴。位于尾骨端，督脉之气由此上行。善治肛肠疾患，为治疗痔疮、脱肛、便血的首选穴。兼能安神定志，治疗癫狂。针刺时紧靠尾骨前面斜刺，注意消毒。
description_en: DU-1 (Changqiang) is the starting point and luo-connecting point of the Du Mai (Governing Vessel). Located between the coccyx and anus, it is the foremost point for anorectal disorders including hemorrhoids, rectal prolapse, and bloody stool. It also calms the spirit for mania. Needling should be directed anteriorly along the coccyx with strict asepsis.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

location.zh: 骶部，正中线上，骶管裂孔中
location.en: On the sacrum, on the midline, in the sacral hiatus

actions.en: regulates menstruation and clears heat
frees the channels and quickens the connecting vessels
scatters cold and eliminates dampness

indications.en: lumbosacral pain, lower limb atrophy and impediment

description_zh: 腰俞位于骶管裂孔中，为督脉穴。善治腰骶部疼痛及下肢痿痹，兼能调经。骶管裂孔为骶管麻醉的重要标志，临床须准确定位。
description_en: DU-2 (Yaoshu) is located in the sacral hiatus on the midline. It treats lumbosacral pain and lower limb motor disorders, and regulates menstruation. The sacral hiatus is an important anatomical landmark for caudal epidural procedures.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

location.zh: 腰部，后正中线上，第四腰椎棘突下凹陷中
location.en: On the lumbar spine, on the posterior midline, in the depression below the spinous process of the 4th lumbar vertebra

actions.en: strengthens the lumbus and supplements the kidney
dispels cold and eliminates dampness
relaxes the sinews and quickens the connecting vessels

indications.en: lumbosacral pain, lower limb atrophy and impediment

description_zh: 腰阳关位于第四腰椎棘突下，为督脉阳气通行之关隘。善壮腰补肾、祛寒除湿，为治疗腰痛及下肢痿痹的重要穴位。灸治效果尤佳，常用于肾阳不足所致的腰膝冷痛、遗精阳痿。
description_en: DU-3 (Yaoyangguan) is located below the L4 spinous process, at a key "gate" for yang qi flow in the lumbar spine. It strengthens the lumbus and supplements the Kidney, treating lumbago, lower limb weakness, impotence, and menstrual irregularity. Moxibustion is particularly effective for Kidney yang vacuity patterns with cold-damp lumbar pain.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

location.zh: 背部，后正中线上，第九胸椎棘突下凹陷中
location.en: On the back, on the posterior midline, in the depression below the spinous process of the 9th thoracic vertebra

actions.en: relaxes the sinews and stops spasm
levels the liver and extinguishes wind
quiets the heart and calms the spirit

description_zh: 筋缩位于第九胸椎棘突下，穴名寓意「筋脉挛缩」。善舒筋止痉、平肝息风，为治疗癫痫抽搐、脊柱强直的要穴。位近肝俞，故兼治肝气郁结所致诸症。
description_en: DU-8 (Jinsuo) is located below the T9 spinous process. Its name ("Sinew Contraction") reflects its function of relaxing spastic sinews. It is a primary point for epilepsy, convulsions, and spinal rigidity. Its proximity to the Liver shu point gives it additional efficacy for Liver qi stagnation.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

location.zh: 背部，后正中线上，第七胸椎棘突下凹陷中
location.en: On the back, on the posterior midline, in the depression below the spinous process of the 7th thoracic vertebra

actions.en: disinhibits the gallbladder and abates jaundice
broadens the chest and rectifies qi
frees yang and dissipates nodules

description_zh: 至阳位于第七胸椎棘突下，穴名含「阳气至此而极」之意，为背部阳气最盛之处。善利胆退黄、宽胸理气，为治疗黄疸的要穴。兼治胸闷胁痛及背部疼痛。临床常与阳陵泉配伍治疗胆系疾患。
description_en: DU-9 (Zhiyang) is located below the T7 spinous process, where yang qi reaches its zenith in the back. It is a critical point for jaundice (often paired with GB-34), and for broadening the chest to relieve oppression. It also treats hypochondriac pain and back pain.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

location.zh: 背部，后正中线上，第六胸椎棘突下凹陷中
location.en: On the back, on the posterior midline, in the depression below the spinous process of the 6th thoracic vertebra

actions.en: diffuses the lung and stops cough
clears heat and resolves toxin
quiets the heart and calms the spirit

description_zh: 灵台位于第六胸椎棘突下，穴名含「灵验高台」之意。善宣肺止咳、清热解毒，治疗咳嗽气喘及疮疡肿毒。为背部督脉穴位之一，兼能宁心安神。
description_en: DU-10 (Lingtai) is located below the T6 spinous process. It diffuses the Lung to stop cough and wheezing, and clears heat to resolve toxin for boils. Its name ("Spirit Platform") also reflects its ability to calm the spirit.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

location.zh: 背部，后正中线上，第五胸椎棘突下凹陷中
location.en: On the back, on the posterior midline, in the depression below the spinous process of the 5th thoracic vertebra

actions.en: quiets the heart and calms the spirit
clears heat and extinguishes wind
frees the connecting vessels and stops pain

description_zh: 神道位于第五胸椎棘突下，与心俞穴同一水平。穴名「神道」寓意心神之通道，善宁心安神，为治疗心悸失眠、惊恐不宁的要穴。兼治癫痫及背部疼痛。
description_en: DU-11 (Shendao) is located below the T5 spinous process, at the level of the Heart shu point. Its name ("Spirit Path") reflects its primary function of calming the spirit. It is an important point for palpitations, insomnia, anxiety, and epilepsy.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

location.zh: 背部，后正中线上，第三胸椎棘突下凹陷中
location.en: On the back, on the posterior midline, in the depression below the spinous process of the 3rd thoracic vertebra

actions.en: diffuses the lung and clears heat
calms the spirit and settles spasm
supplements vacuity and detriment

description_zh: 身柱位于第三胸椎棘突下，穴名含「身体支柱」之意。善宣肺清热、宁神镇痉，为小儿保健灸的重要穴位之一。主治咳喘、癫痫惊风及脊背疼痛。日本针灸界尤重身柱灸，视为小儿百病之要穴。
description_en: DU-12 (Shenzhu) is located below the T3 spinous process. Its name ("Body Pillar") reflects its role as a structural and energetic support for the body. It is important for cough, wheezing, epilepsy, and infantile convulsions. In Japanese acupuncture tradition, it is particularly esteemed as a health-preservation moxibustion point for children.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

location.zh: 背部，后正中线上，第一胸椎棘突下凹陷中
location.en: On the back, on the posterior midline, in the depression below the spinous process of the 1st thoracic vertebra

actions.en: resolves the exterior and clears heat
interrupts malaria
calms the spirit and settles the mind

description_zh: 陶道位于第一胸椎棘突下，为督脉与足太阳交会穴。善解表清热、截疟退热，为治疗疟疾及外感发热的要穴。兼治骨蒸潮热等虚热证。
description_en: DU-13 (Taodao) is located below the T1 spinous process, a meeting point of the Du Mai and Foot Taiyang channel. It resolves the exterior and clears heat, and is a traditional point for interrupting malaria. It also treats steaming bone tidal fever and headache with stiff neck.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

location.zh: 项部，后正中线上，第一颈椎（寰椎）棘突下凹陷中，后发际正中直上0.5寸
location.en: On the nape, on the posterior midline, in the depression below the spinous process of the 1st cervical vertebra (atlas), 0.5 cun above the midpoint of the posterior hairline

depth.method: 伏案正坐，向下颌方向缓慢刺入

actions.en: opens the portals and arouses the spirit
benefits the throat and tongue
extinguishes wind and stops spasm

indications.en: sudden aphonia, stiff tongue with inability to speak, deaf-mutism

cautions_zh: 严禁深刺或向上斜刺，针尖朝向下颌方向，深度不超过1寸。深部为延髓，误刺可致生命危险。禁灸。
description_zh: 哑门为督脉与阳维脉交会穴，穴名「哑门」直指其善治哑证。为治疗暴喑、舌强不语、聋哑的首选穴，兼治癫狂痫证。因深部为延髓，操作须极为谨慎，严禁深刺及向上斜刺，禁灸。
description_en: DU-15 (Yamen) is a meeting point of the Du Mai and Yangwei vessel. Its name ("Gate of Muteness") indicates its primary function of treating speech disorders: sudden aphonia, stiff tongue, and deaf-mutism. CRITICAL CAUTION: the medulla oblongata lies deep to this point -- needling must be directed toward the mandible, never upward, and depth must not exceed 1 cun. Moxibustion is contraindicated.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

location.zh: 头部，后正中线上，风府穴直上1.5寸，枕外隆凸上缘凹陷中
location.en: On the head, on the posterior midline, 1.5 cun above DU-16 (Fengfu), in the depression on the upper border of the external occipital protuberance

actions.en: arouses the brain and opens the portals
extinguishes wind and stops spasm
brightens the eyes

description_zh: 脑户位于枕外隆凸上缘，为督脉与足太阳交会穴。穴名「脑户」直指其近脑之位置，善醒脑开窍、息风止痉，为治疗头痛眩晕、癫痫的常用穴。
description_en: DU-17 (Naohu) is located at the upper border of the external occipital protuberance, a meeting point of the Du Mai and Foot Taiyang channel. Its name ("Brain's Door") reflects its proximity to the brain. It treats headache, dizziness, epilepsy, and eye disorders by arousing the brain and opening the portals.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

location.zh: 头部，前正中线上，前发际正中直上1寸
location.en: On the head, on the anterior midline, 1 cun directly above the midpoint of the anterior hairline

actions.en: frees the nasal portals
clears the head and brightens the eyes
quiets the spirit and settles the mind

indications.en: deep-source nasal congestion (sinusitis), epistaxis, nasal obstruction

description_zh: 上星位于前发际上1寸，善通鼻窍、清头目，为治疗鼻渊（鼻窦炎）、鼻衄、鼻塞的要穴。兼治前额头痛、目眩及精神疾患。
description_en: DU-23 (Shangxing) is located 1 cun above the anterior hairline. It is a primary point for opening the nasal passages, treating sinusitis, epistaxis, and nasal obstruction. It also clears the head for frontal headache and dizziness.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

location.zh: 头部，前正中线上，前发际正中直上0.5寸
location.en: On the head, on the anterior midline, 0.5 cun directly above the midpoint of the anterior hairline

special_categories: 督脉与足太阳足阳明交会穴

actions.en: calms the spirit and arouses the brain
clears the head and scatters wind
frees the nasal portals

description_zh: 神庭位于前发际上0.5寸，为督脉与足太阳、足阳明交会穴。穴名「神庭」寓意「神之宫庭」，善宁神醒脑，为治疗失眠、头痛、癫狂的要穴。兼治鼻部疾患。头皮针常取此穴区域。
description_en: DU-24 (Shenting) is located 0.5 cun above the anterior hairline, a meeting point of the Du Mai, Foot Taiyang, and Foot Yangming channels. Its name ("Spirit Court") reflects its potent spirit-calming function. It is an important point for insomnia, headache, epilepsy, and mania. It is frequently included in scalp acupuncture protocols.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

location.zh: 面部，鼻尖正中
location.en: On the face, at the tip of the nose

actions.en: opens the portals and arouses the spirit
frees the nasal portals
clears heat and disperses swelling

description_zh: 素髎位于鼻尖正中，为督脉面部要穴。善通鼻窍、开窍醒神，为治疗鼻部疾患及急救穴位之一。可用于昏迷休克的急救，点刺出血尤能止鼻衄。
description_en: DU-25 (Suliao) is located at the tip of the nose. It opens the nasal portals for nasal obstruction, epistaxis, and sinusitis, and arouses the spirit in emergency situations such as coma and shock. Pricking to bleed is effective for epistaxis. Moxibustion is contraindicated.

verification.reviewer: Bencaodian Editorial / 本草典编辑部

location.zh: 面部，人中沟上1/3与下2/3交点处
location.en: On the face, at the junction of the upper one-third and lower two-thirds of the philtrum

special_categories: 督脉与手足阳明交会穴

actions.en: arouses the brain and opens the portals
returns yang and rescues from counterflow
extinguishes wind and stops spasm
harmonizes yin and yang

indications.zh: 昏迷、晕厥、中暑、休克（急救第一要穴）
indications.en: coma, syncope, heatstroke, shock (the foremost emergency acupoint)

description_zh: 水沟又名人中，为督脉与手阳明、足阳明交会穴，孙思邈十三鬼穴之一。被公认为中医急救第一要穴，位于人中沟上1/3处，为一切昏迷急症的首选穴位。【急救应用】凡遇昏厥、晕倒、中暑、癫痫发作、中风昏迷、溺水急救、新生儿窒息等紧急情况，首选水沟穴。操作方法：以拇指甲掐按或用毫针向上斜刺0.3-0.5寸，用强刺激手法（雀啄泻法），以患者苏醒或眼球湿润为度。如遇心跳骤停，应同时配合现代心肺复苏术。水沟穴急救的机理在于其强烈刺激通过三叉神经传入，兴奋网状激活系统，促使患者苏醒。本穴还善治急性腰扭伤（令患者活动腰部同时针刺），以及癫狂痫证。为历代医家急救必取之穴。
description_en: DU-26 (Shuigou), commonly known as Renzhong ("Person's Center"), is the single most important emergency acupoint in Chinese medicine. It is a meeting point of the Du Mai, Hand Yangming, and Foot Yangming channels, and one of Sun Simiao's thirteen ghost points. EMERGENCY PROTOCOL: DU-26 is the first-line acupoint for ALL loss-of-consciousness emergencies: syncope, coma, heatstroke, wind-stroke, shock, drowning, epileptic seizure, and neonatal asphyxia. Technique: press firmly with the thumbnail or insert a needle obliquely upward 0.3-0.5 cun using strong reducing stimulation (pecking technique) until the patient regains consciousness or the eyes moisten. In cardiac arrest, combine with modern CPR. The mechanism involves trigeminal nerve afferent stimulation activating the reticular activating system to restore consciousness. Beyond emergency use, DU-26 is also highly effective for acute lumbar sprain (needle while the patient moves the waist) and for mania and epilepsy. It has been the paramount emergency point across all dynasties of Chinese medicine.

location.zh: 会阴部，男性在阴囊根部与肛门连线的中点，女性在大阴唇后联合与肛门连线的中点
location.en: In the perineum, at the midpoint between the anus and the root of the scrotum in males, or the midpoint between the anus and the posterior labial commissure in females

actions.en: arouses the spirit and opens the portals
regulates menstruation and stops vaginal discharge
frees and benefits urination and defecation

description_zh: 会阴为任脉起始穴，任脉、督脉、冲脉三脉之交会穴。位于前后阴之间，为人体阴气之总汇。善醒神开窍，可用于溺水窒息等急症；亦善治下焦疾患，如阴痒、痔疮、小便不利等。因位置特殊，临床应用须注意患者隐私及严格消毒。
description_en: REN-1 (Huiyin) is the starting point of the Ren Mai (Conception Vessel) and the meeting point of the Ren, Du, and Chong vessels. Located in the perineum, it is a convergence of yin qi. It can resuscitate consciousness in drowning and asphyxia emergencies, and treats perineal disorders including hemorrhoids, genital itching, and urinary difficulty. Strict asepsis and patient privacy must be maintained.

location.en: On the lower abdomen, on the anterior midline, at the midpoint of the upper border of the pubic symphysis

actions.en: frees and benefits urination
regulates menstruation and stops vaginal discharge
warms the kidney and invigorates yang

description_zh: 曲骨为任脉与足厥阴肝经交会穴，位于耻骨联合上缘。善通利小便，为治疗泌尿系统疾患的要穴。兼能温肾壮阳、调经止带，治疗生殖系统疾患。针刺前须嘱患者排空膀胱。
description_en: REN-2 (Qugu) is a meeting point of the Ren Mai and Foot Jueyin (Liver) channel, located at the upper border of the pubic symphysis. It is a primary point for urinary disorders including retention, incontinence, and enuresis, and treats reproductive disorders such as impotence and menstrual irregularity. The bladder must be emptied before needling.

actions.en: supplements the kidney and assists yang
frees and benefits the bladder
regulates menstruation and stops vaginal discharge

cautions_zh: 针刺前须排空膀胱。孕妇慎用。
description_zh: 中极为膀胱之募穴，任脉与足三阴经交会穴。作为膀胱募穴，为诊治膀胱腑证的首选穴，善通利小便。又为足三阴交会穴，兼调肝脾肾三脏，广泛用于泌尿生殖系统疾患，包括月经不调、痛经、遗精及不孕。
description_en: REN-3 (Zhongji) is the front-mu collecting point of the Bladder and a meeting point of the Ren Mai with the three foot yin channels. As the Bladder mu point, it is the foremost point for bladder disorders and urinary dysfunction. Its intersection with the three yin channels extends its efficacy to gynecological and reproductive disorders including dysmenorrhea, infertility, and seminal emission.

disinhibits water and disperses swelling
frees and regulates the triple burner

indications.en: uterine flooding and spotting, vaginal discharge

cautions_zh: 古代文献有「针之不孕」的记载，孕妇禁针。
description_zh: 石门为三焦之募穴。善通调三焦、理气利水，主治水肿、腹痛及泄泻。古代文献有「石门针之不孕」的记载，故孕妇禁针，临床使用须审慎。
description_en: REN-5 (Shimen) is the front-mu collecting point of the San Jiao (Triple Burner). It regulates the Triple Burner, rectifies qi, and disinhibits water for edema, abdominal pain, and diarrhea. CAUTION: classical texts warn that needling this point may cause infertility; it is contraindicated in pregnancy.

actions.en: disinhibits water and disperses swelling
frees and regulates the waterways
fortifies the spleen and rectifies qi

description_zh: 水分位于脐上1寸，穴名「水分」直指其分清泌浊、利水消肿之功。为治疗水肿、腹水的要穴，善通调水道、分利小便。灸治水肿效果尤佳。
description_en: REN-9 (Shuifen) is located 1 cun above the umbilicus. Its name ("Water Divide") directly indicates its function of separating the clear from the turbid and regulating water metabolism. It is a primary point for edema, ascites, and urinary difficulty. Moxibustion is particularly effective for water retention.

fortifies the spleen and disperses accumulation

description_zh: 下脘位于脐上2寸，为任脉与足太阴脾经交会穴。与中脘（REN-12）、上脘（REN-13）合称「三脘」，三穴分治胃之上中下部疾患。下脘善和胃消食、降逆止呕，主治食积不化、胃痛腹胀。
description_en: REN-10 (Xiawan) is located 2 cun above the umbilicus, a meeting point of the Ren Mai and Foot Taiyin (Spleen) channel. Together with REN-12 (Zhongwan) and REN-13 (Shangwan), it forms the "Three Epigastric Points." It harmonizes the Stomach and disperses food stagnation, treating indigestion, stomach pain, and vomiting.

description_zh: 上脘位于脐上5寸，为任脉与足阳明、手太阳交会穴。与中脘、下脘合称「三脘」。上脘主治胃之上部疾患，善和胃降逆、化痰宁神。为治疗呕吐、呃逆的要穴，兼治痰浊型癫痫。
description_en: REN-13 (Shangwan) is located 5 cun above the umbilicus, a meeting point of the Ren Mai, Foot Yangming, and Hand Taiyang channels. It treats the upper portion of the Stomach, harmonizing counterflow to stop vomiting and hiccup. It also transforms phlegm for epilepsy of the phlegm-turbidity type.

description_zh: 巨阙为心之募穴，位于脐上6寸。作为心之募穴，善宁心安神，为治疗心痛、心悸、癫狂的首选募穴。兼治上消化道疾患，如呕吐呃逆。穴名「巨阙」意为「大剑」，形容其守护心脏之重要性。
description_en: REN-14 (Juque) is the front-mu collecting point of the Heart. As the Heart mu point, it is the primary point for diagnosing and treating Heart disorders: heart pain, palpitations, and chest oppression. It also calms the spirit for mania and epilepsy, and treats upper GI symptoms. Its name ("Great Tower Gate") evokes its role as guardian of the Heart. Avoid deep needling due to the superior liver margin.

harmonizes the stomach and bears counterflow downward
quiets the spirit and settles the mind

cautions_zh: 不可深刺，防止刺伤肝脏。
description_zh: 鸠尾为任脉络穴，位于剑突下。穴名「鸠尾」因剑突形似鸠（斑鸠）之尾而得名。善宽胸化痰、安神定志，为治疗胸闷、癫痫及呕吐的要穴。作为络穴，联络督脉，调和全身阴阳。
description_en: REN-15 (Jiuwei) is the luo-connecting point of the Ren Mai, located below the xiphoid process. Named for the dove-tail shape of the xiphoid, it broadens the chest, transforms phlegm, and calms the spirit. It treats chest oppression, epilepsy, and vomiting. As the Ren Mai luo point, it connects to the Du Mai, harmonizing overall yin-yang balance.

special_categories: 任脉与足太阴少阴交会穴

actions.en: broadens the chest and rectifies qi
quickens the blood and frees the connecting vessels
stops cough and calms wheezing
promotes lactation

description_zh: 膻中为心包之募穴，八会穴之气会，任脉与足太阴、足少阴交会穴。又称「气海」（上气海），为宗气汇聚之处。作为气会，统治一切气机失调疾患。临床以宽胸理气、止咳平喘见长，为胸闷、心痛、咳喘的要穴。兼能通乳，治疗产后乳少。为胸部最重要的腧穴之一。
description_en: REN-17 (Danzhong, also known as Shanzhong) is the front-mu collecting point of the Pericardium and the hui-meeting point of qi (one of the eight influential points). Known as the "Upper Sea of Qi," it is where gathering qi (zong qi) converges. As the influential point of qi, it commands all qi disorders throughout the body. It is clinically indispensable for chest oppression, cardiac pain, cough, and wheezing, and is also used to promote lactation. It is one of the most important points on the entire chest.

depth.method: 先直刺0.2寸，然后将针尖转向下方，沿胸骨柄后面刺入

actions.en: broadens the chest and rectifies qi
transforms phlegm and benefits the throat
bears counterflow downward and stops vomiting

cautions_zh: 针刺操作须谨慎，先直刺再转向下方沿胸骨后壁滑入，禁止向两侧偏斜。深部有气管及大血管。
description_zh: 天突为任脉与阴维脉交会穴，位于胸骨上窝。善化痰利咽、宽胸降逆，为治疗咳喘、咽喉肿痛、梅核气及瘿气的要穴。针刺操作须特别小心，先直刺浅入再沿胸骨后壁向下，深部有气管及大血管。
description_en: REN-22 (Tiantu) is a meeting point of the Ren Mai and Yinwei vessel, located in the suprasternal fossa. It is a primary point for throat and respiratory disorders: cough, wheezing, sore throat, plum-pit qi (globus), and goiter. NEEDLING TECHNIQUE requires special care: insert perpendicularly 0.2 cun, then redirect the needle tip downward behind the sternum. The trachea and great vessels lie deep to this point.

actions.en: benefits the throat and tongue
disperses swelling and stops pain
dispels wind and transforms phlegm

indications.zh: 舌强不语、暴喑、吞咽困难
indications.en: stiff tongue with inability to speak, sudden aphonia, dysphagia

description_zh: 廉泉为任脉与阴维脉交会穴，位于舌骨上缘。穴名含「清泉」之意，善利喉舌，为治疗舌强不语、失语、吞咽困难的首选穴。尤善治中风后语言障碍。针刺时向舌根方向斜刺。
description_en: REN-23 (Lianquan) is a meeting point of the Ren Mai and Yinwei vessel, located above the hyoid bone. Its name ("Honest Spring") evokes fluid flow, reflecting its function of benefiting the tongue and throat. It is the premier point for speech disorders: post-stroke aphasia, stiff tongue, sudden loss of voice, and difficulty swallowing. Needle obliquely toward the root of the tongue.

actions.en: dispels wind and frees the connecting vessels
engenders fluid and stops thirst
disperses swelling and stops pain

indications.en: deviation of mouth and eye, facial swelling

description_zh: 承浆为任脉终止穴，任脉与足阳明交会穴。穴名「承浆」意为承接口中津液。善祛风通络、生津止渴，为治疗口眼歪斜、齿痛及流涎的要穴。任脉至此穴终止，与督脉交会，完成任督循环。
description_en: REN-24 (Chengjiang) is the terminal point of the Ren Mai and a meeting point with the Foot Yangming channel. Its name ("Receiving Fluid") indicates its function of engendering fluids. It treats facial paralysis, toothache, drooling, and mouth sores. As the final point of the Conception Vessel, it connects with the Governing Vessel, completing the Ren-Du circuit.
